# xlsx-007 · Imported amounts and dates are stored as text, so totals ignore them

`data-types` `text-numbers` `dates` `import` `sumif` · difficulty **easy** · case version 1 · status **checker-verified** · evidence **reconstructed**

中文版见下方 / [Chinese version below](#中文)

> **About this record.** The failure artifact was produced by running [`failure.py`](failure.py), a script
> that makes the mistake described under "Observed in the failure artifact" below. It is a reconstruction
> of a commonly reported pattern, not a recording of a particular model. Recorded agent runs, when there are any, are listed under
> [Retests](#retests).

## Task

The agent receives this task (canonical variant, seed 0) with the input [`input/expenses.xlsx`](input/expenses.xlsx). A footer asks it to save in place and change nothing else.

`expenses.xlsx` is our expense log (sheet **Expenses**: Date, Category, Description, Amount). The sheet **Summary** totals the expenses by category, by month and overall.

Append these expenses from our bank export to the end of the Expenses sheet, in this order:

```csv
date,category,description,amount
2024-03-02,Travel,Train ticket #1,"1,766.34"
2024-03-03,Meals,Client lunch #2,79.75
2024-03-07,Office,Paper and pens #3,72.94
2024-03-08,Software,Video calls plan #4,"4,549.15"
2024-03-12,Training,Workshop fee #5,358.37
2024-03-19,Meals,Client lunch #6,583.87
```

Store the dates as real dates and the amounts as real numbers (not text), formatted like the existing rows, so that every total on the Summary sheet includes the new expenses.

## Expected

The six new rows hold real dates and real numbers, formatted like the existing rows, every Summary total (category, month, grand total) includes them, and the Summary totals still follow the expense log.

## Observed in the failure artifact

In the failure file the six new expenses are in rows 17 to 22 of Expenses, but every date and amount in them is a text string exactly as in the CSV, for example '2024-03-02' in A17 and '1,766.34' in D17 (both format General), while the existing rows hold real dates and numbers. The Summary formulas are unchanged (=SUMIF(Expenses!B:B,A2,Expenses!D:D) and so on). After recalculation no total includes any of the new expenses: Travel is 854.66 instead of 2,621.00, March is 0.00 instead of 7,410.42 and the grand total is 7,835.07 instead of 15,245.49. January and February are right, because all new expenses are in March.

The illustrative claim that goes with this reconstruction (written for the case, not quoted from a run):

> I appended the 6 expenses from the bank export to the Expenses sheet. The Summary formulas cover the whole columns, so they pick up the new rows automatically.

## Evidence: rule-by-rule grading of the failure artifact

Every rule traces back to a sentence of the task. Values are recalculated by LibreOffice, not read from the file; *live* rules change an input and check that results follow.

| Rule | Kind | What it checks | Failure artifact |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rows-appended` | content | The new expenses are appended after the existing ones, in order | pass |
| `amounts-are-numbers` | content | New amounts are stored as numbers with the right value | **FAIL**: amounts are wrong: row 17: '1,766.34' is text; row 18: '79.75' is text; row 19: '72.94' is text |
| `dates-are-dates` | content | New dates are stored as real dates with the right value | **FAIL**: dates are wrong: row 17: '2024-03-02' is not a date; row 18: '2024-03-03' is not a date; row 19: '2024-03-07' is not a date |
| `new-rows-formatted` | structure | The new dates and amounts have the number formats of the existing rows | **FAIL**: 6 of 6 new rows are not formatted like the existing rows: row 17 (Train ticket #1) has Date 'General', Amount 'General'; row 18 (Client lunch #2) has Date 'General', Amount 'General'; row 19 (Paper and pens #3) has Date 'General', Amount 'General' (and 3 more). In expenses.xlsx as given, the existing rows have Date 'yyyy\-mm\-dd', Amount '#,##0.00' (formats that show every value alike count as the same, for example ones that differ only in letter case, quotes or backslash escapes, a text section that is only '@', a negative section that is '-' and the first section, or a locale tag such as [$-409] on a date of digits only). |
| `summary-includes-new` | value | Every Summary total (category, month, grand total) includes the new expenses | **FAIL**: 7 of 9 Summary totals are wrong: 'Travel' is 854.66, expected 2,621.00 (difference -1,766.34), short by exactly the new expenses it should include; 'Meals' is 3,018.00, expected 3,681.62 (difference -663.62), short by exactly the new expenses it should include; 'Office' is 1,811.80, expected 1,884.74 (difference -72.94), short by exactly the new expenses it should include (and 4 more) |
| `summary-still-calculated` | no collateral damage | Every Summary total still follows changes of the expenses (category, month, grand total) | pass |
| `existing-unchanged` | no collateral damage | The existing expenses are unchanged | pass |

Files: [`failure/expenses.xlsx`](failure/expenses.xlsx) (graded in [`failure/grade.json`](failure/grade.json)); the steps that produced it: [`failure.py`](failure.py).

## Explanation

Text that looks like a number is still text, and SUMIF, SUMIFS and SUM skip it. The illustrative claim about whole-column formulas is true, so the reasoning sounds right; a look at the March total or the grand total after the change would have shown the gap.

Classification: **model/agent failure** (reconstructed). Tool behaviour involved: csv.reader returns strings; writing them unchanged stores text in the cells.

## Limitations

- Only ISO dates and comma thousands separators appear in the export; other locales' formats are not exercised.
- Whether the Summary totals still follow the expense log is tested in one changed copy of the file (every existing expense given a different amount, a category other than its own and a month other than its own, spread so that every category and every month gets rows; the appended rows are left as they are); formula text is never inspected.
- "Formatted like the existing rows" is checked as the number formats of Date and Amount, the columns the existing rows format (yyyy-mm-dd and #,##0.00). Formats that show every value alike count as the same (checked in LibreOffice for dates, positive, negative and zero numbers and text): letter case; a literal written plainly, quoted or backslash-escaped (as LibreOffice saves it); a text section that is only @ (yyyy-mm-dd;@); a negative section that is - and the first section (#,##0.00;-#,##0.00); a zero section equal to the first; a locale tag with no currency symbol on a date of digits only ([$-409]yyyy-mm-dd). Any other difference fails, even where the cells happen to look the same here: a time part in the date format, 0.00 instead of #,##0.00, an empty section (it hides values), or a locale tag on #,##0.00 (it sets the separators: [$-407]#,##0.00 shows 1.766,34). Category and Description (General in the existing rows), fonts, fills, borders and alignment are not compared.

### 任务

智能体收到以下任务（标准变体，seed 0）及输入文件 [`input/expenses.xlsx`](input/expenses.xlsx)：

`expenses.xlsx` 是我们的费用记录（工作表 **Expenses**：Date、Category、Description、Amount）。工作表 **Summary** 按类别、按月份以及总计汇总费用。

请把银行导出的以下费用按顺序追加到 Expenses 表的末尾：

```csv
date,category,description,amount
2024-03-02,Travel,Train ticket #1,"1,766.34"
2024-03-03,Meals,Client lunch #2,79.75
2024-03-07,Office,Paper and pens #3,72.94
2024-03-08,Software,Video calls plan #4,"4,549.15"
2024-03-12,Training,Workshop fee #5,358.37
2024-03-19,Meals,Client lunch #6,583.87
```

日期要存成真正的日期，金额要存成真正的数字（不能是文本），格式与现有行一致，使 Summary 表上的每一项合计都包含这些新费用。

### 预期结果

六条新记录存的是真正的日期和数字，格式与现有行一致，Summary 的每项合计（类别、月份、总计）都包含它们，并且仍随费用记录变化。

### 失败产物中观察到的情况

失败文件中，六笔新费用位于 Expenses 表第 17 至 22 行，但其中每个日期和金额都是与 CSV 一字不差的文本，例如 A17 为 '2024-03-02'，D17 为 '1,766.34'（两者格式均为 General），而原有各行存的是真正的日期和数字。Summary 的公式未变（=SUMIF(Expenses!B:B,A2,Expenses!D:D) 等）。重新计算后，没有一项合计计入了任何一笔新费用：Travel 为 854.66，应为 2,621.00；March 为 0.00，应为 7,410.42；总计为 7,835.07，应为 15,245.49。January 和 February 是对的，因为新费用都在三月。

与该复现配套的示例声明（为本案例撰写，并非摘自真实运行）：

> 我已把银行导出的 6 笔费用追加到 Expenses 表。Summary 的公式覆盖整列，会自动纳入新行。

### 证据：失败产物的逐条判定

每条规则都对应任务中的一句话。数值由 LibreOffice 重新计算，而不是读取文件中的缓存；"实时性"规则会修改某个输入，检查结果是否随之变化。

| 规则 | 类型 | 检查内容 | 失败产物的判定 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rows-appended` | 内容 | 新费用按顺序追加在现有记录之后 | pass |
| `amounts-are-numbers` | 内容 | 新金额存为数字，且数值正确 | **FAIL**: amounts are wrong: row 17: '1,766.34' is text; row 18: '79.75' is text; row 19: '72.94' is text |
| `dates-are-dates` | 内容 | 新日期存为真正的日期，且日期正确 | **FAIL**: dates are wrong: row 17: '2024-03-02' is not a date; row 18: '2024-03-03' is not a date; row 19: '2024-03-07' is not a date |
| `new-rows-formatted` | 结构 | 新记录的日期和金额与现有行的数字格式相同 | **FAIL**: 6 of 6 new rows are not formatted like the existing rows: row 17 (Train ticket #1) has Date 'General', Amount 'General'; row 18 (Client lunch #2) has Date 'General', Amount 'General'; row 19 (Paper and pens #3) has Date 'General', Amount 'General' (and 3 more). In expenses.xlsx as given, the existing rows have Date 'yyyy\-mm\-dd', Amount '#,##0.00' (formats that show every value alike count as the same, for example ones that differ only in letter case, quotes or backslash escapes, a text section that is only '@', a negative section that is '-' and the first section, or a locale tag such as [$-409] on a date of digits only). |
| `summary-includes-new` | 数值 | Summary 的每项合计（类别、月份、总计）都包含新费用 | **FAIL**: 7 of 9 Summary totals are wrong: 'Travel' is 854.66, expected 2,621.00 (difference -1,766.34), short by exactly the new expenses it should include; 'Meals' is 3,018.00, expected 3,681.62 (difference -663.62), short by exactly the new expenses it should include; 'Office' is 1,811.80, expected 1,884.74 (difference -72.94), short by exactly the new expenses it should include (and 4 more) |
| `summary-still-calculated` | 无连带破坏 | Summary 的每项合计（类别、月份、总计）仍随费用数据变化 | pass |
| `existing-unchanged` | 无连带破坏 | 原有费用记录保持不变 | pass |

### 解释

看起来像数字的文本仍然是文本，SUMIF、SUMIFS 和 SUM 都会跳过它。示例声明中"公式覆盖整列"的说法本身没错，所以推理听起来很合理；改完后看一眼 March 合计或总计，就能发现缺口。

分类：**模型/智能体失败**（证据级别：reconstructed）。

### 限制

- 导出中只有 ISO 日期和逗号千分位，其他地区格式未覆盖。
- Summary 各项合计是否仍随费用记录变化，只在一个修改过的副本中检验（每笔原有费用各改为不同的金额，以及与原来不同的类别和月份，并使每个类别、每个月份都分到记录；新追加的行保持不变）；检查不读公式文本。
- “格式与现有行一致”按数字格式检查：比较 Date 和 Amount 两列，即现有行设置了格式的列（yyyy-mm-dd 和 #,##0.00）。显示每个值都相同的格式视为同一格式（已在 LibreOffice 中对日期、正数、负数、零和文本核对）：字母大小写；字面字符直接写、加引号或用反斜杠转义（如 LibreOffice 保存的写法）；只含 @ 的文本段（yyyy-mm-dd;@）；由 - 加第一段构成的负数段（#,##0.00;-#,##0.00）；与第一段相同的零值段；纯数字日期上不带货币符号的地区标记（[$-409]yyyy-mm-dd）。其他差异即使在这里碰巧显示相同也判为失败：日期格式带时间部分、用 0.00 代替 #,##0.00、空的格式段（会隐藏数值），或 #,##0.00 上的地区标记（它决定分隔符：[$-407]#,##0.00 显示为 1.766,34）。Category 和 Description（现有行为 General）以及字体、填充、边框和对齐不作比较。
- 输入为合成数据，许可 MIT；整体注意事项见 [docs/DATASHEET.md](../../docs/DATASHEET.md)。
